**Observation Log:**

[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/24 (Wed) 03:57  
[USER] User inquired about how SWIFT has adapted to advancements in technology in recent years.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] SWIFT has introduced new features and technologies to its global financial messaging network.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] SWIFT gpi (global payments innovation) enhances cross-border payments by providing real-time information on transaction status, fees, and exchange rates.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] SWIFT uses APIs (Application Programming Interfaces) to allow third-party developers to access its network and create new services and applications.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] SWIFT has improved its cybersecurity measures by introducing ISO 2022 messaging standards and enhancing message validation and authentication processes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] SWIFT has partnered with other technology companies and financial institutions to create new solutions, such as the SWIFT Access for corporates program.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Overall, SWIFT has embraced advancements in technology to enhance the security, transparency, and efficiency of its messaging network.  
[USER] User asked about notable collaborations between SWIFT and technology companies in recent years.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] SWIFT has partnered with various technology companies in the past to enhance its messaging network.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] In 2019, SWIFT partnered with R3 to integrate SWIFT gpi with Corda, R3's blockchain platform.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] This integration allows Corda users to initiate and track SWIFT gpi payments directly from their platform.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] SWIFT partnered with Microsoft Azure to launch SWIFT's Customer Security Programme (CSP) in the cloud.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] These collaborations demonstrate how SWIFT is leveraging technology companies to enhance its services.  
[USER] User inquired about the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on SWIFT's services and operations.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The pandemic led to many of SWIFT's staff working remotely, causing disruptions in daily operations.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] SWIFT faced challenges in ensuring the security and stability of its messaging network while employees worked from home.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The company implemented measures to enhance cybersecurity and protect its systems from cyber threats.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The pandemic accelerated the trend towards digitalization and contactless transactions, leading to increased use of SWIFT's electronic services.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] SWIFT increased network capacity and improved connectivity to ensure reliable services during the increased demand.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] SWIFT's events and conferences had to be canceled or moved online due to social distancing measures.
